issues: Rows contain no ТР ТС / раздел section headings anywhere in the document (it lists ГОСТ standards and apробation instructions only), so tr_section is null on every row. Several rows list two alternate units/ranges joined by '/' in the source cell (e.g. '(0,00-100,00) % / (0 - 4000) шт/кг' in item 3, or 'обнаружено / не обнаружено (X-Y) unit' in items 11-13,15,16): range_from/range_to were taken from the numeric bracket and the qualitative descriptor plus original unit text were kept together in the unit field to avoid dropping data; raw_row_text always preserves the untouched original text. Item 9 (ГОСТ 12042, п.3, Масса 1000 семян) lists two disjoint numeric ranges for the same indicator; emitted as two rows. TN VED code '120400100' (item 1/2/3/... full code list) is printed with only 9 digits in the source (one digit short of the usual 10-digit format used elsewhere) — transcribed exactly as printed, not corrected. Item 17's OKPD2/TN VED cells list truncated group-level codes (e.g. '01.11', '1001') rather than full codes, as printed on the page. No rotated or illegible pages; all 8 pages read cleanly.
